description: Returns Harcourt Valuations' published net asset value per share, price to NAV, commodity, assets and model date for a covered mining company, or the whole coverage list when no ticker is given. A direct read of Harcourt's published figures: exact, fast and free. Each figure is valued at the metal prices of its model date, which is returned with it, not at today's prices.

ticker.description: Ticker or company name, for example "SA", "Seabridge" or "IVN". Omit to list every covered company.

name: get_published_nav
title: Harcourt's published NAV for a covered miner
